where: The Pale Vault Undercroft + the Hourfold (the deep-ice site of the Still Hour); returns after Noctilune is caught
mood: Glasslight — the glacier as a lush luminous reverie: ringing suspended chords, bell entries blooming and dissolving into echo; vast, sacred, still.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
suspended C major with a Lydian F sharp glint
soft bell-pad lead with long shimmering tones
lush sustained suspended string pad chords
deep warm still low string pad
a single soft reversed-cymbal swell every four bars, free-floating and beatless
vast sacred ice cavern lit from within, awe and stillness

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a quiet luminous entrance: a reversed-cymbal swell breathes in, a high glass chime rings and echoes into the dark, a deep pad wakes beneath}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {slow bell entries: a rising lift G, C, D blooming into a sustained suspended chord, then a descending settle that dissolves into echo; glassy arpeggios turning above}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the bell melody again, doubled by a soft high string line, the chime arpeggio layering into a shimmering canopy, the Lydian F sharp glinting}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a hushed dip to A minor and F major, the bells fall silent and only the pad and a low solemn line remain, like midnight held in the ice, then a swell rises}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the bells return luminous over the full suspended chords; the last bar holds a D suspended colour that dissolves straight back into the opening lift}
